title: Wolves at the edge of camp

turns.content: Deep in the night, the horses start stamping and snorting. I hear something moving in the brush beyond the firelight.

Brennic is awake before I finish turning, a short blade already in his hand. "Don't run toward it. Build the fire up." He keeps his voice low and flat. "Wolves don't want us. They want the mule at the back, eh, friend?"
I throw the rest of the kindling onto the fire. Sparks shoot up and three pairs of eyes glint at the edge of the trees.
He steps between the fire and the picket line and stands very still, the blade low. "Shout when I say. Loud. Bang the pot." He waits until the nearest pair of eyes creeps forward, then barks, "Now!"
I bang the cookpot with a ladle and yell at the top of my lungs. The drivers wake up and join in. The eyes vanish into the dark.

Brennic lets out a long breath and sheathes the blade. "They'll circle. Won't come back while the fire's high." He sits down facing the trees instead of the flames. "Go to sleep. I've got the rest of the night. Leg hurts too much to sleep anyway."
I ask if he wants me to stay up with him.
"No." A pause. "But leave the pot where I can reach it."
